map.摘要生成器（基于句子权重） 使用指南: Summary Generator (Sentence Weight Based) User Guide
map.按句子权重抽取文本关键句生成摘要，可调摘要长度与句子数，适合长文速读与要点提炼，: Extract key sentences from text by sentence weight to generate a summary, with adjustable summary length and sentence count, for speed-reading long texts and distilling key points; pure front end, text is not uploaded.
map.句权计算：评估各句重要度。: Sentence weighting: assess the importance of each sentence.
map.摘要抽取：取高分句组成摘要。: Summary extraction: take the highest-scoring sentences to form the summary.
map.可调长度：控制摘要句数。: Adjustable length: control the number of summary sentences.
map.：示例：千字文抽取 3 句关键句作摘要。: : Example: extract 3 key sentences from a thousand-character text as the summary.
map.按位置与词频近似评分，非语义理解。: Scored approximately by position and word frequency, not semantic understanding.
map.为粗略提取，重要句可能遗漏，需人工核对。: It is a rough extraction and important sentences may be missed, so it needs manual checking.
map.长文速览与笔记辅助。: Speed-reading long texts and note-taking support.
